Definition: Goshen, the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Goshen is the land in Egypt where Joseph settled his family, and where Israel lived until the exodus. It was the best of the land, set apart for them while famine pressed on Egypt, and it stayed their home until Moses led them out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Goshen matters because God's story happened in real places, and Goshen is one of them.
